subject.title: Feishu (and non-Discord channels) should apply sanitizeAssistantVisibleText() on outbound text

question: Should this umbrella finish as audited per-channel `sanitizeText` hooks, or should OpenClaw move `sanitizeAssistantVisibleText()` to a shared outbound delivery boundary for all channels by default?
rationale: Both shapes can fix the leak, but the shared-boundary option changes the stripping contract for every channel while per-channel hooks leave ongoing audit burden and uneven coverage.

options.title: Finish per-channel hooks
options.body: Land or close the existing channel-slice PRs and keep sanitization explicit in each adapter, minimizing global behavior change at the cost of continued audit work.

options.title: Move to shared boundary
options.body: Apply the delivery sanitizer centrally, then add opt-out or skip semantics only where a channel proves legitimate content would be over-stripped.

options.title: Pause for security policy
options.body: Hold the remaining PRs until maintainers define the exact user-visible internal-scaffolding policy for channels and failure banners.

recommendation.title: Finish per-channel hooks
recommendation.body: Land or close the existing channel-slice PRs and keep sanitization explicit in each adapter, minimizing global behavior change at the cost of continued audit work.
